verdict.rationale: Docs mention Droid running from terminal/editor/tests and CI pipelines (factory-docs-2, factory-docs-6, factory-docs-17) and put 'QA on autopilot' (factory-docs-14), implying some test-related automation, but there is no explicit documentation of an agent autonomously writing new tests, executing them, and using results to validate its own diff before proposing it. missing for 10: explicit description of automatic test generation, a validation loop tied to test results, and any hands-on evidence confirming this workflow.
